global_caption: The video consists of 10 shots and is a realistic cool-toned food advertisement, primarily using icy blue, snow white, and deep sea gray as its color palette to emphasize a crisp, authentic premium quality. The entire sequence is presented in a Chinese advertising context, with no character Lighting relies mainly on natural cool light and minimal rim lighting, maintaining a consistent mood of crispness and healing.
shot1: Shot 1 opens with a fade-in, wide shot, slightly low-angle composition, with vast snowy mountains occupying the main background. She is positioned in the lower third of the frame, her coat and scarf gently fluttering in the cold breeze. Cold white natural light illuminates snow particles. The camera slowly pushes in while smoothly tracking her movement. As the first piano arpeggio plays, the mountain wind
shot2: Shot 2 follows with a hard cut from the previous shot, close-up, eye-level composition. The gift box is placed on a rocky snow surface, foreground features ice crystals, focus locked on the lid and her hands. As she opens the ice bucket-style outer packaging, cold mist slowly escapes from the gap and drifts forward toward the lens. The background snow is blurred to create depth. A slight side-backlight outlines the mist edges. The camera makes a small tilt-down motion to match the opening action. In On the upper right area of the screen, large icy white three-dimensional Chinese characters briefly flash and overlay the image, styled like frosted ice crystals with subtle cold glow.
shot3: Shot 3 transitions via a matching action hard cut to a spruce forest edge, medium close-up, side-eye-level composition. A transparent tall cup sits at the boundary between rock and forest floor, foreground has blurred foliage, background features dark cool spruces and thin fog. A handful of fresh blueberries falls from above into the cup, bouncing slightly after hitting the glass wall. A base layer of snow-white yogurt already exists at the bottom. Shallow depth of field emphasizes the berry motion. Natural cool light filters through tree gaps creating soft dappled patterns. The camera performs a slight downward tilt to follow the berries' fall.
shot4: Shot 4 transitions via fade-in/fade-out to a streamside scene, close-up, low-angle eye-level composition. The transparent cup is placed near a cold stream, with the background water forming moving highlights. The elderly woman slowly pours yogurt, which overflows along the rim in a full arc and falls in slow motion. Foreground mist and background stream rocks enhance the cold sensation. Backlight renders the yogurt edge soft, bright, and thick. The camera slowly pushes in to emphasize fluid viscosity. In Simultaneously, vertical icy white Chinese characters densely overlay the left side of the screen, appearing like ad text emerging from cold mist.
shot5: Shot 5 cuts hard from the previous shot, close-up, eye-level composition. A spoon lifts a strand of thick yogurt from the cup's rim, focus tightly locked on the junction between spoon tip and string. Blueberry jam at the cup’s edge is faintly visible. Background is completely blurred into cool gray-blue blocks. Shallow depth of field highlights texture. Soft cool light glides across the yogurt string surface, revealing fine textures and slow descent weight. The camera slightly pulls back to create a suspended feeling.
shot6: Shot 6 transitions via rhythmic hard cut to a mountain summit workstation, dynamic composition shifting from wide to medium shot. Starting with an overhead view, it quickly pulls to a medium shot. Her arm firmly holds the cup. Background features wind-sliced clouds and distant mountain lines. Cold daylight illuminates flying ice particles. Local backlight creates sharp edges on water droplets. The camera starts with an overhead shot, then moves in a small arc around the cup. A set of bold icy white Chinese characters suddenly appears in the center, resembling frosted glass, entering rapidly from small to large.
shot7: Shot 7 connects via a soft cut after wind The woman stands at the cliff edge, behind her lies a cool-colored sea horizon and churning white waves. She raises a cup filled with blueberry yogurt, her lips showing a reserved yet genuine smile. Her hair is gently blown by sea wind. The cup, backlit, reveals blue-white layers. The camera slowly pans and slightly pushes in, concluding the journey emotion “从雪山抵达海边”. Overall emotion shifts subtly from crispness to openness.
shot8: Shot 8 cuts hard into an extreme close-up, extreme close-up, eye-level composition. The lens is close to the cup wall, water droplets slowly roll down the cold condensation glass. Inside, blueberry jam and snow-white yogurt form swirling textures. Foreground shows fine cold beads on the glass surface, background is fully abstracted. Depth of field is extremely shallow, focus on a single droplet about to fall and the rotating jam pattern behind it. Side-backlight gives each droplet a three-dimensional highlight. The camera moves horizontally at an extremely slow speed.
shot9: Shot 9 transitions via liquid texture match cut to an overhead close-up, overhead composition. The table surface changes to a cold gray plane on seaside rocks. The tall cup is centered. A second layer of yogurt is slowly poured from above, piling up a thick, rounded crown on top of the blueberry layer. The liquid surface rises, trembles slightly, then stabilizes. A few scattered blueberries in the foreground serve as visual guides. The background sea is compressed into soft color bands. Lighting remains cold and naturally white. The camera performs a very slight downward push from a static overhead position, emphasizing the thickness change “再倒一层”. In Piano continues arpeggios toward the climax. Semi-transparent icy white text blocks begin to appear at the bottom of the screen as a final chapter preview.
shot10: Shot 10 concludes with a fade-in freeze-frame, a long-to-medium product hero shot, eye-level composition. The person retreats into the blurred background, only retaining a sense of presence. The foreground cup outline is sharp, crown is rich, jam texture is clearly visible. Sea wind carries a faint cold mist across the base. Natural backlight during twilight hour traces a bright edge along the cup rim. The camera first slightly pushes in, then stabilizes into a fixed frame. The final piano arpeggio rings out clearly. Ocean waves sustain the image in the tail note. At the same time, icy white Chinese characters “真冷”“真浓”“真顺滑” densely overlay the entire screen in a layered press style. The three groups of text are positioned at top, middle, and bottom, using semi-transparent frost-like 3D material with soft cold glow. Their entrance effect is a far-to-near compression, layer-by-layer entry without obscuring the core product silhouette, ultimately forming a high-density, highly recognizable advertising conclusion.
